text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's king Hassan II receives French Accor group officials. Accor signs a $100 million investment fund with the Moroccan government to develop tourism.
- Moroccan police dismantle a prostitution gang operating in Saudi Arabia from the city of Casablanca.
- Toll of the "road war": more than 1,100 people killed and 26,000 injured in road accidents in the first half of 1996.
- Government representatives and university teachers' union officials meet to discuss teachers' working conditions.
